compressionRoundsTooltip: Number of recent conversation turns to keep uncompressed when compression triggers. Older turns beyond this count will be compressed into a summary
compressionModelTooltip: AI model used to generate conversation summaries, you can choose a lower-cost model
maxAttachedTurnsTooltip: Number of complete conversation turns retained per model call. Must be greater than compression rounds to trigger summary compression
maxIterationsTooltip: Maximum number of model call rounds (including tool calls) in a single conversation. Automatically terminates when exceeded
title: Title

validation.optionsRequired: Please configure at least one option

optionsHint: One option per line, format: label:value, or just label (value same as label)
copyVariableHint: Click copy button to copy variable (format: [[variableCode]]) to clipboard
iframeEmbeddingTooltip: Embed the conversation page of the bot into your website or application
apiEmbeddingTooltip: Integrate the chatbot’s conversational capabilities into your application or service via the API
sdkEmbeddingTooltip: Embed the conversation page of the bot into your website or application via the SDK script
webSearchToolDesc: When enabled, AI can use search engines to get real-time web information
webCrawlerToolDesc: Fetch web page content by URL
todoWriteToolDesc: Automatically decompose complex tasks into multiple executable subtasks and complete them step by step
voiceConfigDesc: Enable voice input for users to talk with the bot. Voice recognition service must be configured in system settings first.
textFileAutoParseTooltip: When enabled, text files (txt, md, json, etc.) will be automatically parsed into text content for the model to process
imageUseVlModelTooltip: When enabled, images will be processed using a dedicated vision-language model; when disabled, the current chat model will be used
vlModelTooltip: Vision-language model for processing images, can select 'Use Current Chat Model' (requires current model to support multimodal) or select a specific VL model
attachmentNotEnabled: Attachment feature is not enabled, please enable it in Bot settings
compareSelectTip: Please select at least two versions to compare
